description: This Java class 'UpdateRateCommandHandler' handles the 'UPDATE' command for 'RATE' entities within the Fineract project. It processes commands to update interest or rate-related data, leveraging the RateWriteService.

classes.name: UpdateRateCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service component that handles update commands for rate entities, invoking the RateWriteService's updateRate method.

methods.name: UpdateRateCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the RateWriteService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to update a rate, executing the update via RateWriteService and returning the result.
